key.name: unit
key.description: Display temperatures in Fahrenheit ("f") or Celsius ("c").

key.name: location-mode
key.description: How the location is determined: automatic (IP-based), city name, or ZIP code.

key.name: location
key.description: City name or ZIP code used when location-mode is "city" or "zip".

key.name: appearance
key.description: Override styling of the dropdown menu: follow the system, or force light/dark.

key.name: glyph-style
key.description: Color emoji glyphs or monochrome unicode symbols.

key.name: provider
key.description: Weather data source: wttr.in or Open-Meteo. Both are free and need no API key.

key.name: show-glyph
key.description: Whether to show the conditions glyph in the top bar.

key.name: show-temp
key.description: Whether to show the current temperature in the top bar.

key.name: show-alerts
key.description: Whether to fetch and display US National Weather Service alerts (warnings and watches) for the current location.
